title: UAAP: Payosing, UP pull away in second half to overwhelm Ateneo
summary: University of the Philippines came alive in the second half to overwhelm Ateneo de Manila University in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Saturday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
